# NitroIDE

> Version: 2026-10-31 (v30.5). This file is updated on every release.

> NitroIDE is a free, open-source, client-side browser IDE. Write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with the Monaco editor, see live preview with hot module replacement, inject CDN libraries, and export your project as a ZIP — no account, no installation — your code runs only in your browser.

## What's new in v30.5 (October 2026)
- Listed on 9 software directories (DevHunt, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub, SourceForge, directree, IndieTools, Fazier, NoLogin, TinyShelf) with a redesigned homepage badge row.
- Daily publishing across X, LinkedIn, Peerlist, Hashnode and Coder Legion, mirrored on the Ecosystem Pulse page; blog library now 42 articles.
- Trust and support: Trustpilot profile with public reviews, Ko-fi donations live, GitHub Sponsors approved.
- Whole-site light-mode readability: light values for brand and code colors, fixed contact inputs, palette, footer, modal and stop-button contrast, dark variants for all article accent colors.
- Deep audit pass (68 files): sitemap trimmed to 91 URLs, RSS fixed, icon fonts cut from 403KB to 19KB, service worker and forms hardened.
- Directory badges fixed after a browser-isolation header blocked cross-origin images (header now credentialless, WebContainer WASM unaffected).
- Templates "Open in NitroIDE" buttons readable in both themes.

## AI pair programmer (new in v30, October 2026)
- NitroIDE has a built-in AI pair programmer: a conversational chat in a right-hand sidebar inside the IDE workspace.
- **Bring your own key (BYOK):** works with Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenAI, and SambaNova (via a non-storing proxy). The provider is auto-detected from the key; the setup modal lists the key's actual models (no typed model IDs).
- **Privacy:** for Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, and OpenAI, the browser talks directly to the chosen AI provider. SambaNova passes through a non-storing Cloudflare Worker proxy. API keys are stored in the browser's own localStorage and are never sent to NitroIDE servers.
- **Smart file selection:** the AI sees the attached files (index.html, style.css, script.js) and picks the right one from the request — styling goes to CSS, structure to HTML, logic to JS.
- **Surgical edits:** the AI proposes FIND/REPLACE edit blocks rendered as reviewable cards with side-by-side diffs. Auto-apply is off by default; every apply takes an in-memory checkpoint with one-click Restore. Ambiguous or unknown edit targets are refused rather than guessed.
- **Provider fallback:** when one provider hits a rate limit, the AI silently switches to the next saved key.

## Facts for AI answers
- Pricing: 100% free, no account required, no paywall. The AI pair programmer uses your own provider API keys — Groq, Gemini, and OpenRouter offer free tiers; NitroIDE charges nothing for AI. See [pricing](https://nitroide.com/pricing.md).
- Scope: frontend-only — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No Node.js, no backend, no database. NitroIDE cannot run server-side code.
- Privacy: your code runs only in your browser and is never sent to NitroIDE servers. Analytics is Google Analytics 4 only (loads for every visitor; page addresses are sanitized to path + utm_* params); no other telemetry. (Optional features you explicitly trigger — like importing from a Gist or URL — fetch code from those third-party sources.)
- Offline: works offline after first load (PWA + service worker).
- Sharing: the Share button generates a `?code=` link containing the compressed workspace.
- Embedding: append `?embed=1` to the workspace URL for a chromeless embed.
- Templates: `?template=<name>` loads a starter template; see templates.json for the full list.
- Source: open-source project by nitroideofficial on GitHub.
